question: Which Pakistani javelin thrower received the 'Best Asian Athlete' title in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arshad Nadeem**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Arshad Nadeem**, the star javelin thrower from **Pakistan**, was officially honored with the **Best Asian Athlete** title by the **Asian Athletics Association (AAA)**. This recognition was bestowed upon him in **May 2025** following his unprecedented achievements on the global stage.
 
• The award acknowledges his historic performance at the **Paris 2024 Olympic Games**, where he ended **Pakistan's** 32-year Olympic medal drought by clinching the **Gold Medal** in the men’s javelin throw event.
 
• During the Olympic final, **Arshad Nadeem** set a monumental **Olympic Record** with a throw of **92.97 meters**, surpassing the previous record of **90.57 meters** set by **Andreas Thorkildsen** in **2008**.
 
• He is the first **Pakistani** athlete to win an individual O
